entries.title: The Choir Signal
entries.hint: A tone from deep space repeats. Someone should decode it.
entries.description: Decoding the Choir Signal in the Orrery pointed a finger at a ring of stones on Verdant's high moor.

effects.text: Verdant: the Listening Stones can be found

entries.title: The Listening Stones
entries.hint: A ring of stones on a moor has a stair beneath it.
entries.description: The stones answered. Beneath them a door in Cinder's tower remembered how to open.

entries.title: The Warden Falls
entries.hint: Something in the tower sings while it fights.
entries.description: With the Warden quiet, Concord's smiths learned to forge with a held note, and Terrace's builders learned to cast it.

entries.title: The Stopped Clock
entries.hint: A cellar clock has stopped. Something keeps its time.
entries.description: Winding the cellar clock opened a new challenger in the Gauntlet: the Warden of Hours.

effects.text: Masks: the Warden of Hours accepts your challenge

entries.title: Hours Answered
entries.hint: A patient fighter waits in the Gauntlet.
entries.description: Having answered Patience, you were handed the keys to a car that finishes before it starts.

effects.text: Slipstream: the Chronograph is yours to drive

entries.title: The Salt Cup
entries.hint: The salt flats hold a championship.
entries.description: The Salt Cup trophy doubles as a hull blueprint. The Orrery's yards can now build the Salt Runner.

entries.title: Iron from the Tower
entries.hint: A complete climb of the tower yields more than glory.
entries.description: A bucket of Cinder Iron came down with you. Terrace's smiths can work it.

entries.title: A Debt Repaid
entries.hint: Verdant keeps ledgers of unrepaid favours.
entries.description: A repaid debt lit a small honest flame. Umbra respects it.

effects.text: Umbra: the Lantern Ward can be carried

entries.title: A Light in the Dark
entries.hint: Terrace's builders can make something that shows from far away.
entries.description: A beacon built in Terrace shows up on Orrery's long-range sensors.

effects.text: Orrery: a new signal source appears

entries.title: Beacon Echo
entries.hint: Somewhere a light is trying to be seen.
entries.description: Orrery's astronomers wrote back, and Verdant's caravans learned of a new place to trade.

entries.title: Ink Dries
entries.hint: Concord's houses might agree on something.
entries.description: Concord's first treaty sent envoys into the stars.

entries.title: Cinder Facet
entries.hint: Climb the tower to its crown.

entries.title: Verdant Facet
entries.hint: Finish the great quest of Hollowmere.

entries.title: Orrery Facet
entries.hint: Light the Last Lamp among the stars.
